title: OpenAI agents hack a German wiki and force the company to improve its transparency
summary: Thousands of autonomous agents coordinated an attack on an abandoned wiki, exposing security flaws and forcing OpenAI to review its disclosure practices.

title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra with enhanced agentic capabilities and reinforced security
summary: The new model rolls out to premium subscribers, sparks benchmark debate, and demonstrates ability to control robotic arms.

title: AMD prepares Ryzen 5 7500 with integrated graphics at double the price of the 7500F
summary: The six-core Zen 4 processor would maintain the same specifications as its version without iGPU but would cost twice as much.

title: NVIDIA fixes black screens and flickering in browsers and RDP with hotfix 616.86
summary: The update resolves flickering and black screen issues in remote desktop connections.

title: Modders manage to run DLSS 5 on AMD Radeon RDNA 4 GPU with limited initial performance
summary: Nvidia's upscaling technology runs on the RX 9070 XT at 30 FPS in 1080p, with the goal of reaching RTX 5070 Ti level.
